intro: My teaching starts with substantive questions and equips students with the computational tools to investigate them. Through hands-on practice and accessible materials, I help students of any technical background build practical skills and the confidence to pursue their own questions. My goal is for students to leave with resources they can return to and methods they can adapt to new problems.

quotes: TA Do Won Kim prepared us well for the labs and explained everything in great detail. The best!
